high_level_description: The image depicts a woman standing in what appears to be a formal event or gala. The cuffs feature large, round, metallic elements that resemble bells or decorative ornaments, adding a touch of glamour to her outfit. The dress has a fitted silhouette with a slit on the left side, revealing one of her legs.
